comingLast.roast: off 30 and blue - the friendliest wooden spoon in the field
escape requires 5 over the last 6 - his mates have started filming
on 17, needs 5 - somebody radio ahead to the bar
his round is over, his sweating is not - 2 above the line
done and dangling 2 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
his round is over, his sweating is not - 3 above the line
in the clubhouse 4 above Pollock - cheering for him from a safe distance
finished 4 clear of the blue balls - now buying Pollock drinks out of gratitude
in the clubhouse 5 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
safe by 5 unless the course gets generous late
